title: feat(java): Add Auto Refresh
description: Adds ElastiCacheIamAuthTokenManager: lazy token caching, background refresh, a single shared mint across concurrent callers, retry with jittered backoff while serving a valid token, token-change callbacks, and close semantics.

acceptance_criteria.text: Concurrent callers share one in-flight token mint.
A cached token is served only while it is valid for use, and refresh failures retry with backoff.
Every failure, including Errors, completes shared refresh state so later requests can recover.
close() stops refresh and no token is published after close.

defects.summary: A zero-delay refresh replaces the failure cooldown, so reconnect traffic can trigger back-to-back mint attempts.
close() can run after the closed check, and the token is still installed and published after close.
Tokens are served through the raw 900-second expiry instead of the effective lifetime, so a reconnect can get a token that expires in transit.
onTokenChanged runs before refresh completes, so a blocking callback delays the first getToken() caller and occupies the only scheduler thread.
Error causes are not unwrapped for waiters: the minting caller gets the original Error while callers on the same future get CompletionException.

label_notes: Unlabeled: two test-reliability comments (single-flight proof, Thread.yield loop).
